hooks.name: grimoire-env-secret-ward-read
hooks.description: Blocks built-in file reads and searches that target real .env files (.env.example stays readable). Exit code 2 blocks the tool call without exposing the file.

hooks.name: grimoire-env-secret-ward-shell
hooks.description: Blocks shell commands that touch .env files, dump the environment (printenv, env, set, Get-ChildItem env:), or print secret-named variables such as $OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

hooks.name: grimoire-env-secret-ward-mcp
hooks.description: Applies the same .env and environment-dump rules to every MCP tool call.
